seo.title: Teresa Valdez | Tucson Real Estate Agent, Text Me First
seo.description: Tucson real estate agent Teresa Valdez. Meet her first, then see how she sells and buys homes in midtown, the foothills and the west side. Text her anytime.

hero.headline: Hi, I'm Teresa. Ask me anything before you hire a Tucson agent.
hero.sub: Most people pick the first agent they talk to. So talk to me first, the way you'd talk to a friend: by text. Tap a question and I'll answer it here, or text me the real one.

opening: Born at St. Mary's, raised off Grant Road, still here. Two kids, one very loud heeler named Chile.

a: Fair question. I taught 4th grade for nine years before real estate, so I explain things until they make sense, not until I'm tired of explaining.
And I'll tell you when a house is wrong for you, even if it means another month of looking.
School drop-off at 7:40. Showings and calls till 3. Pickup. Paperwork after bedtime.
Saturdays are open houses and soccer, in that order. You'll see it all on my calendar below.

qa.q: How do you sell a house?
a: We walk it together and I tell you the three things a buyer will notice first. Usually it's small stuff.
Then real photos, a price backed by the last 90 days of sales, and a weekly text with every showing and what people said.
Commission is negotiable and we agree on it in writing before we start. No surprises at closing.
Buyers: we sign a short agreement before touring that spells out exactly what I'm paid and who pays it.
Midtown is home, but I sell all over Tucson: Sam Hughes, the foothills, Marana, the west side.
I just know which streets flood in monsoon season, because I grew up driving them.

week.headline: My week, the real version
week.sub: You'll be trusting me with a big decision, so here's how my week actually looks. My family is on the same calendar as my clients, and I plan both on purpose.

work.headline: Okay, now the agent part
work.sub: Here is exactly what happens when you hire me, whether you're selling or buying.

sides.name: If you're selling
steps: We walk your house and I tell you the three things buyers will notice first.
I price it from the last 90 days of real sales near you, and show you every comp.
Real photos, a floor plan and a video walkthrough before it goes live.
A text every Friday: every showing, every bit of feedback, nothing hidden.
I run the offers, the inspection and the appraisal until the keys change hands.

sides.name: If you're buying
steps: A 20-minute coffee to learn what you actually need, not just beds and baths.
A lender introduction if you want one, so you know your number first.
Showings on your schedule, with notes from me on every house.
I write offers that sellers take seriously, and I tell you when to walk away.
I stay on it through inspection, appraisal and closing, and after.

faq.q: Do I have to sign anything to talk to you?
faq.a: No. Texting, coffee and questions are free. If you want to tour homes, we sign a short written buyer agreement first, as the rules now require, and it says exactly what I'm paid.
It's negotiable, and we put it in writing before any work starts. I'll walk you through what's included so you can compare me to anyone else.

faq.q: Can you help if I'm moving to Tucson from out of state?
faq.a: Yes. Video tours, a list of inspectors and lenders I trust, and a straight answer on monsoon season, scorpions and summer power bills.

faq.q: How fast will you get back to me?
faq.a: Usually within 10 minutes during the day. If I'm at a closing or my kid's game, I'll reply by that evening.
